schema.help: Walking here also means walking with a pushchair, a cane or another aid.

options.text: No, only short bits (e.g. to a stop or the car) or not at all

schema.text: In a typical week, do you make at least one trip where you walk or use a wheelchair most of the way?

ar.#In a typical week, do you make at least: هل تقوم في أسبوع عادي برحلة واحدة على الأقل تمشي فيها أو تستخدم كرسيًا متحركًا في معظم الطريق؟
ar.#No, only short bits (e.g. to a stop or: لا، فقط مسافات قصيرة (مثل الوصول إلى محطة أو السيارة) أو لا أمشي أبدًا
ar.#Walking here also means walking with a: المشي هنا يشمل أيضًا المشي مع عربة أطفال أو عكاز أو أداة مساعدة أخرى.

de.#In a typical week, do you make at least: Machen Sie in einer typischen Woche mindestens einen Weg, den Sie größtenteils zu Fuß oder im Rollstuhl zurücklegen?
de.#No, only short bits (e.g. to a stop or: Nein, nur kurze Stücke (z. B. zur Haltestelle oder zum Auto) oder gar nicht
de.#Walking here also means walking with a: Gehen schließt hier auch das Gehen mit Kinderwagen, Stock oder einer anderen Hilfe ein.

en.#In a typical week, do you make at least: In a typical week, do you make at least one trip where you walk or use a wheelchair most of the way?
en.#No, only short bits (e.g. to a stop or: No, only short bits (e.g. to a stop or the car) or not at all
en.#Walking here also means walking with a: Walking here also means walking with a pushchair, a cane or another aid.

fa.#In a typical week, do you make at least: آیا در یک هفته معمولی حداقل یک سفر دارید که بیشتر مسیر آن را پیاده یا با ویلچر بروید؟
fa.#No, only short bits (e.g. to a stop or: نه، فقط بخش‌های کوتاه (مثلاً تا ایستگاه یا خودرو) یا اصلاً
fa.#Walking here also means walking with a: پیاده‌روی در اینجا شامل پیاده‌روی با کالسکه، عصا یا وسیله کمکی دیگر هم می‌شود.

fr.#In a typical week, do you make at least: Pendant une semaine habituelle, faites-vous au moins un trajet où vous marchez ou roulez en fauteuil roulant la plupart du temps ?
fr.#No, only short bits (e.g. to a stop or: Non, seulement de courts tronçons (p. ex. jusqu'à un arrêt ou à la voiture) ou pas du tout
fr.#Walking here also means walking with a: Ici, marcher inclut aussi marcher avec une poussette, une canne ou une autre aide.

hu.#In a typical week, do you make at least: Egy átlagos héten legalább egy olyan útja van, amelynek nagy részét gyalog vagy kerekesszékkel teszi meg?
hu.#No, only short bits (e.g. to a stop or: Nem, csak rövid szakaszokat (pl. a megállóig vagy az autóig), vagy egyáltalán nem
hu.#Walking here also means walking with a: A gyaloglás itt a babakocsival, bottal vagy más segédeszközzel való járást is jelenti.

it.#In a typical week, do you make at least: In una settimana normale, fai almeno uno spostamento in cui vai a piedi o in sedia a rotelle per la maggior parte del tragitto?
it.#No, only short bits (e.g. to a stop or: No, solo tratti brevi (ad es. fino a una fermata o all'auto) o per niente
it.#Walking here also means walking with a: Qui camminare vuol dire anche camminare con un passeggino, un bastone o un altro ausilio.

tr.#In a typical week, do you make at least: Tipik bir haftada, yolun çoğunu yürüyerek veya tekerlekli sandalyeyle yaptığınız en az bir yolculuk yapıyor musunuz?
tr.#No, only short bits (e.g. to a stop or: Hayır, yalnızca kısa bölümler (örn. durağa veya otomobile kadar) veya hiç
tr.#Walking here also means walking with a: Burada yürümek, bebek arabası, baston veya başka bir yardımcıyla yürümeyi de kapsar.
